9thwonders.com.b: 9thwonders.com takes its name from Isaac Mendez 's in-world comic book, 9th Wonders. The site was started by the show's writers, who were inspired by The Fuselage, ABC's official site for the creative team behind Lost.

Assignment Tracker 2.0.b: The Company keeps a database of files about its contacts. Some of these contacts include Company agents, bag and tag targets, and associates of the Company.

Assignment tracker map.b: The map, which records tips, leads, and assignments related to evolved humans, shows several tip markers of varying colors. Blue tips denote Company assignments, green tips denote verified tips about evolved humans, and red leads denote general tips which have not yet been confirmed.

CorinthianLasVegas.com.b: History is littered with hundreds of conflicts over the future of a community, group, location or business that were "resolved" when one of the parties stepped ahead and destroyed what was there. With the original point of contention destroyed, the debates would fall to the wayside.

Heroes Survival.b: Heroes: Survival is a part of NBC.com 's Heroes Evolutions experience that allows players to create characters and role-play as their advisor in the Heroes universe.

Hiro's Blog.b: Hiro's blog is hosted directly on NBC.com. Most of the entries claim to be "auto translated by: Yamagato Software". Hiro's blog entries are dated using stardates.

LasVegasNiki.com.b: Genesis On the morning of the eclipse, Niki Sanders is performing a striptease for a subscriber, huggerz69. An alarm sounds and she sends him an instant message, telling him his time is up. When he asks for more, she asks for more money, and he calls her a "bitch".

PinehearstResearch.com.b: According to their site, Pinehearst Company is a biotech company, working on becoming one of the nation's leading biotechnology companies. Aspirants may submit their applications in the Careers page.

PrimatechPaper.com.b: Godsend The website address and the phone number (1-800-PRIMA16) appear on a business card that Mr. Bennet gives to Mohinder Suresh. He claims there is an access code on the back of the card.

The Odessa Report.b: Released on September 24, 2015, the same day as the two-hour premiere of Heroes Reborn, the Heroes Reborn channel on YouTube released a video. Entitled "Heroes Reborn - The Odessa Report (Digital Exclusive)", the video is 1:03 minutes.

VotePetrelli.com.b: The site contains biographical information, Nathan's platform, and a campaign video. It was initially comprised of four main pages; a fifth page offering Petrelli campaign merchandise was added after.07% aired. Later, a page was added to allow users to sign up for text message and email updates.

YamagatoFellowship.org.b: The site contains an English translation ( transcript ) of a speech given by Kaito Nakamura (the original speech in Japanese is also available in video form), stating how history has always told the stories of heroes. It also has links to a repository and a videos and events page (which is currently unavailable).

A Hero's Quest.b: After Hiro Nakamura learns that Charlie lived a full life without him, he keeps a blog on yamagatofellowship.org called A Hero's Quest.

A Long Way from Home.b: A group of evos are held against their will at an internment camp controlled by Renautas. They are told — and they believe — that their abilities are harmless, are pointless, and have no real use. But if they want to have a life of freedom, they will have to work together and push their abilities to the limit.

A Matter of Trust.b: A Matter of Trust is an eBook that details the life of Father Mauricio, including his past as a coyote, the discovery of his ability, and the start of the underground railroad.

Bridget's messages.b: Bridget Bailey is a lawyer who had some contact with Chandra Suresh. After Chandra's death, Bridget sends several messages to Mohinder Suresh via email.

Catch and Kill.b: As with the other five eBooks, Catch and Kill was published by Bastei, and fills in the backstory on characters featured in Heroes Reborn. The book was released along with the last five eBooks on November 20, 2015, the day after the fall finale of Heroes Reborn.

Create Your Hero.b: Create Your Hero is a fan-based, interactive promotion on NBC.com which calls upon Heroes fans to vote on various physical and personality attributes for the creation of a new hero. The voting ended on September 29, 2008.

Dirty Deeds.b: Dirty Deeds is an eBook that gives background on James Dearing 's crooked deals, his rise from Lieutenant to Captain within the LAPD, and his constant need to hide the fact that he is an evo.

Evs Dropper's blog.b: After the demise of Evs Dropper, the blog's description was updated to read, "A Company mole named Connie Logan (aka Evs Dropper ) planted a Trojan virus on the Company mainframe to dump info to this website. "After Connie died, agents represented by Liza Messer used the Trojan to ask for help capturing villains.

Heroes Versus.b: Heroes Versus invites Heroes fans to create and vote on "VS" match-ups between characters, abilities, and other elements from the world of Heroes, using photos and videos from the show. It officially launched on September 22, 2008 with the premiere of Season Three.

Heroes: The Mobile Game.b: Heroes: The Mobile Game is a mobile phone game, produced by Gameloft. It was released on October 5, 2007 in the United States, and is available for most handsets on all major carriers.

The government reacts by enacting the Evo Registration Act, and tensions in society rise as humans and evos take sides. For a chapter-by-chapter summary of the book, see here.

Faction Zero.b: The fifth iStory volume is called Faction Zero. The first installment's release coincided with the publication of the graphic novel Rebellion, Part 7.

Operation Bad Blood.b: Operation Bad Blood is the first iStory (or "Interactive Story") in the Friend or Foe volume for users that choose to complete a mission contract with Pinehearst Research Group. The following summaries are for each chapter, and explain what must happen in order for the reader to complete the mission successfully.

Operation Splinter.b: Operation Splinter is the first iStory (or "Interactive Story") in the Friend or Foe volume for users that choose to complete a mission contract with Primatech Executive Services. The following summaries are for each chapter and explain what must happen in order for the reader to complete the mission successfully.

Purpose.b: The eighth iStory volume is called Purpose.

Slow Burn.b: The sixth iStory volume is called Slow Burn. The first installment's release coincided with the airing of the episode Ink. Each chapter is accompanied by a 90-second clip from the the Slow Burn webisode.

The Agent.b: The third iStory volume is called The Agent. It began being released after the second episode of Volume Four of Season Three of Heroes.

The Civilian.b: The fourth iStory volume is called The Civilian. It began being released after the sixth installment of the Rebellion graphic novel arc of Heroes.

The Private.b: The second iStory volume is called The Private. It began being released during the hiatus between Volumes Three and Four of Season Three of Heroes.

The Puppet Master.b: The seventh iStory volume is called The Puppet Master.
